## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run --files docs/index.mdx docs/fern/versions/latest.yml`; all hooks skipped because none apply to these files.
- [x] I reviewed the applicable rules in `AGENTS.md`.
- [x] I added the required change-type, affected-area, and originator labels.

## Affected area

Documentation.

## Summary

Replace the text-only cuDNN overview with a landing page in the existing NVIDIA docs theme. Add Python/C++ setup tabs, operation links, and an interactive integration map. Place the Quick start, Samples, and Open-source kernels cards after Operations.

The map retains the prototype's All paths, Training, Inference, and Direct API filters. Selecting a framework or library highlights its route and shows a short explanation with a documentation link. Selecting it again resets the map. It covers PyTorch, JAX/XLA, Megatron Core, Transformer Engine, vLLM, SGLang, FlashInfer, TensorRT for RTX, and Tokamax.

Use the NVIDIA theme's colors and font in both light and dark mode. Scope the map's styles and events to a page-local MDX component; add no packages or shared theme changes. Keep keyboard controls, visible focus, live route descriptions, and a layout that fits mobile screens.

Reorder the sidebar to Overview, Samples, Release Notes, API Reference, Developer Guide, Installation, and Reference. List operations directly under API Reference, followed by For Agents (formerly Utilities) and the Experimental APIs dropdown (formerly Frontend OSS APIs). Keep Quick Start available from its page card and preserve every page URL.

## Why

Help readers choose an entry point and see how their framework connects to cuDNN while keeping the overview consistent with the rest of the documentation.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Changes are limited to `docs/index.mdx` and `docs/fern/versions/latest.yml`. Preserve the existing overview route and backend API guidance.

## Testing

- `cd docs/fern && fern check --warnings`: 0 errors; one warning because the existing-redirect comparison returned HTTP 403.
- `pre-commit run --files docs/index.mdx docs/fern/versions/latest.yml` and `git diff --check`: passed; no applicable pre-commit hooks.
- Compiled the final page with `@mdx-js/mdx`.
- Checked internal links against Fern navigation and external documentation links.
- Tested the native Fern preview in light and dark mode: all 10 route selections, all four filters, related nodes, deselection, Enter/Space controls, internal links, and navigation away and back.
- Checked 320, 390, 768, and 1440 pixel widths with no page or map overflow. The integration map passed axe WCAG 2/2.1 AA checks at each size in both themes. No browser page errors.
- Reviewed desktop and mobile screenshots, including a selected route.
- Verified the new sidebar order, visible operation links without an Operations dropdown, renamed dropdowns, and Quick Start access. Compared every page route before and after the navigation change; all are unchanged.

The local native preview used a separate copy with the existing unescaped `<=` in `docs/operations/MoeGroupedMatmul.md` corrected locally. That unrelated file is not part of this PR.
